{"text":"ItemID: unavailable; Title: City of Evil; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Melodic heavy riffs fit my recent interest in energetic rock and metal.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Mezmerize; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Its intense vocals and unpredictable rhythms appeal after Ten Thousand Fists and 10.000 Days.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Reise, Reise; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The heavy sound interests me, but I would choose more guitar-driven melodic metal this time.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: The End of Heartache; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: The mix of aggressive riffs and melodic choruses closely matches my interest in In Flames and Soilwork.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Ascendancy; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Its thrashy riffs and melodic passages fit what I enjoy about Advance And Vanquish and Colony.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: St. Anger; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Its raw, repetitive approach is less appealing right now than the melodic metal in my history.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Testify; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am more interested in melodic metal right now than its rap-driven hard rock sound.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Fallen; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The melodic rock sound fits part of my taste, but I want something heavier this time.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Ashes Of The Wake; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: The forceful riffs appeal to the heavier side of my listening, especially after Death Cult Armageddon.
